scope: Exposure-integrated presentation over the fixed native GBA panel frame without changing endpoint feedback state.

stateContract.endpointPass: Pass 0 RGBA32F keeps native optical endpoint RGB and residual-DC alpha for the next emulated frame.
stateContract.exposurePass: Pass 1 computes average emitted native-linear RGB over the same native frame and forwards endpoint residual-DC alpha without feedback.
stateContract.displayPass: Pass 2 applies aperture, optional relative backlight sensitivity, and HCS/neutral host conversion to exposure RGB.
stateContract.endpointDiagnostic: ExposureMode=0 bypasses the frame average and presents the Pass 0 frame-boundary endpoint.

intervalProfiles.frontendEvent: one emulated frame executed and presented once
the emulator executes the next native frame with identical source content
intervalProfiles.note: Identical content is still real panel dwell and must advance GtG and retention.

intervalProfiles.frontendEvent: host repeats a previously presented image without executing an emulated frame
intervalProfiles.note: The Shader cannot observe or reconstruct this elapsed host interval.

intervalProfiles.frontendEvent: every emulated native frame still executes exactly once
intervalProfiles.note: Native panel time remains fixed; accelerated wall-clock presentation is not an AGS physical clock change.

intervalProfiles.frontendEvent: emulated frames are skipped before Shader execution
host present intervals vary but every emulated frame executes once
host timing causes an unknown duplicate/drop history

integration.opticalEquation: For each constant-target segment, x(t)=q+(x0-q)exp(-kt) and integral=q*dt+(x0-q)(1-exp(-k*dt))/k.
integration.ratePolicy: The WS4 runtime rate is frozen at each segment start, matching the existing endpoint pass.
integration.scanPolicy: Changed channels integrate old target before WS3 optical onset and new target afterward; unchanged channels retain one full-frame segment.
integration.retentionPolicy: The exposure pass uses the same boundary residual-DC reductions as the endpoint pass. It does not introduce a new within-segment electrical model.
integration.referenceCheck: Closed-form integrals are compared with composite Simpson integration using at least 4096 subintervals per nonzero segment.

excluded.reason: No transferable low/high ratio or electrical topology.
Frequency, duty, phase, and even PWM use remain unknown; no temporal waveform is invented.

runtimeLimits: The frontend must execute every emulated native frame exactly once.
Host refresh rate does not replace or rescale the native GBA panel clock.
PWM exposure is unavailable until a traceable candidate waveform exists.
